content.text:
I fixed an off-by-one error in `src/offset.js`, and all 4 tests pass now.

The README says pages start at 1, but `offset` treated the page number as if it started at 0 (`page * perPage`). So `pageOf(1)` skipped the five newest issues and returned `[7, 6, 5, 4, 3]` instead of `[12, 11, 10, 9, 8]`. `pageOf(3)` started at position 15, past the end of the 12-issue list, and came back empty.

The fix is one line:

```js
export const offset = (page, perPage) => (page - 1) * perPage;
```

`offset` is only used by `src/page.js`, so nothing else is affected.
